items.question: What is a semantic cocoon?
items.answer: A semantic cocoon is an internal linking strategy that groups related content pages into topic clusters. It helps search engines understand your site's topical authority and improves rankings for targeted keywords.

items.question: Do I need SEO experience to use Meridian?
items.answer: Not at all. Meridian's AI can generate complete cocoon structures from a single topic. If you're experienced, you'll love the granular control over node types, link strategies, and keyword mapping.

items.question: Can I try Meridian for free?
items.answer: Yes! Sign up for a free account to explore the visual builder and create your first project. The free plan includes unlimited projects with local storage.

items.question: What export formats are supported?
items.answer: Meridian supports CSV, JSON, XML sitemap, PDF, and image exports. You can hand off your cocoon plans to writers, developers, or import them directly into your CMS.

items.question: Can I collaborate with my team?
items.answer: Team collaboration is available on the Pro plan. Invite team members to your workspace, share projects, and work together on cocoon strategies in real time.
